newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stocks close higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Indian stocks close higher on short-covering.

text.p: ** (1315 GMT) - Indian shares finish higher, late rally
** Last day of weekly account at Bombay Stock Exchange
** Foreign funds pick up select blue-chip stocks
** Bombay share index gains 28.70 pts to 3,139.02
** National exchange index rises 0.55 pct, Delhi index
0.24 pct, Calcutta 0.18 pct and Madras 0.32 pct
